svg.title: AI, machine learning, generative AI and LLM as nested boxes
svg.desc: Four nested boxes. Artificial intelligence is the largest. Inside it is machine learning, then generative AI, then large language models.
svg.text: The broad field: systems that do tasks we associate with intelligent behaviour
Software that learns patterns from data instead of every rule being hand-written
ML that creates new content: text, images, audio, video, code
A generative model trained on very large amounts of text
Produces: explanations, emails, code, SQL, structured JSON, translations
Much narrower than "AI". This is the part this course focuses on.
A rough picture only: not every useful way of sorting AI fits one hierarchy.
